sources.title: Continuous distillation mini-plant measurements
sources.attribution: Muraleedharan, A., Ferre, A., Arweiler, J., Jungjohann, I., Jirasek, F., Hasse, H., and Burger, J. (2025). Time series data from a continuous distillation plant with and without anomalies. Zenodo, version 1.
conditions: Physical mini-plant measurements; three chemical-system scenarios
Fixed operating points; source includes introduced and naturally occurring anomalies
Pinned version 1: retain original per-file clocks and common/advanced label fields
limitations: A labelled anomaly is not an observed human failure-on-demand
No operator opportunity denominator or independent operator cohort
Version 1 time formats and totals differ from the later article narrative; source bytes govern this study
No inferred facility annual frequency; no startup/shutdown model qualification

sources.title: Steel Industry Energy Consumption
sources.attribution: V E, S., Shin, C., and Cho, Y. (2021). Steel Industry Energy Consumption. UCI Machine Learning Repository.
conditions: Measurements from one South Korean steel facility
Quarter-hour source intervals; use previous measurements only for a rolling next-interval forecast
limitations: No human action, error or recovery outcome
Same-interval power factors and load labels are excluded from forecasting
The CO2 column has inconsistent source unit labels and is not used
Day-ending midnight labels require explicit clock interpretation; raw dates remain preserved and timing claims are conditional on this assumption.

sources.title: Coded Korean railway accident investigations
sources.attribution: Kim, C. (2026). Reproducible data and code for: Assessing Human Error Contributions to Railway Accident Causation. Zenodo.
conditions: C1-C8 are investigator-derived binary codes and may overlap
Use only the released derivative CSV; original investigation reports have a different redistribution boundary
limitations: Case selection is conditioned on a recorded accident
No successful tasks, fleet exposure, or task-opportunity denominator
A code proportion is a case composition, not a human error probability
The CSV does not label a monetary unit; costs are excluded from currency-specific risk integration

sources.title: Gas Turbine CO and NOx Emission Data Set
sources.attribution: Gas Turbine CO and NOx Emission Data Set (2019). UCI Machine Learning Repository.
conditions: One Turkish power plant, source-year files 2011-2015
Ambient-only contemporaneous energy-yield estimation; train/calibrate/evaluate on distinct years
limitations: No human task response or error outcomes
Hourly aggregates are not independent operator opportunities
Cross-year accuracy is within one plant, not evidence for transfer to another plant
